state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stage 10.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv playbook --triage <section>` is on disk (`tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts:707`). Sections `divergences`, `splitting-a-file`, `running-things` and `writing-a-test-case` are decided. `writing-novis` has 120 of its 322 bullets still owed, and `tooling` has 301.

The report's `LIVE MANIFEST` flag now marks a bullet that any goal's manifest selects, including a generated goal with no checks. A bullet with that flag is kept, or its selectors are re-pointed first. Deleting one turns `bun nv chain --check` red across every goal that names it, and that check is on the floor. No goal selects a `writing-novis` bullet today.

A bullet has two homes that are read: the fragment under `docs/agent/playbook/<section>/` and the record under `data/playbook/<section>/`. A batch changes both. `.agent-tmp/triage-splitting.ts <batch.json>` is the batch script. Its batch file is `{ "section", "delete": [ids], "keep": { id: "path:word" } }`, and `.agent-tmp/triage-novis-3.json` is the latest example. The script refuses the whole batch if a `gone` condition does not stand, or if a deleted bullet carries `LIVE MANIFEST`. A `gone` word must not contain `]`. The report's `propose` word is often a poor anchor, so check it with `git grep -c -F`. A diagnostic's code (`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:E0406`) is a good anchor for a language claim. A bullet about numbered module-doc gaps or `Decided:` sheets is about a retired mechanism, because gaps are records under `data/gaps/` now.

`awk '/^== /{p = /OWES A DECISION/} p'` pulls the owed blocks, `grep -v '^  means\|^  file\|^  near'` drops the noise, and `awk '/^== /{n++} n<=40'` takes one batch of about 30 KB.

Probe a language claim with a short `.nvs` under `.agent-tmp/p/` and `target/debug/nvs.exe check`. A free function is `E0215`, so a probe puts functions in a class. The constructor is `constructor`, and a markup literal is written `` html`…` ``. These compile now: `new Core\Task\Channel<int>(2)`, a `Core\Unit` parameter, `$int + Core\Arr::sum($ints)`, `public ?string $s = null`, and a `== null` early return that narrows `?T`. A closure whose parameter type does not match is `E0401` at the call. These are still refused: two `foreach` headers or two loop-body locals with one name at different types (`E0406`), `array<string, string>`, `1.25d`, `T?`, a property default array with entries (`E0472`), `: static` returning `new Own` (`E0741`), `uint` into `Core\Bytes::slice`, and `.` on `bytes`.

The goal-only sweep is red on the four checks later stages own: Stage 9's `audit checks`, Stage 11's `audit ci` and `loop-stats --guard`, and Stage 12's `audit python`, plus Stage 10's trailer check until every section is triaged.
